**Step 10: Quality critique of solver's Step 2 (File Completion dialog) against `internal/ui/bubble/completion.go` — detailed verification.**

The solver's account is comprehensive and accurate. Key confirmations:

- `completion` struct fields: `kind`, `items`/`filteredItems`, `atByteIndex`, `query`, `searchDir`, `prefix`, `allItems`, `selectedIndex`, `loading` — all confirmed present in the struct definition at lines ~20-50.
- `syncAtCompletion()` calls `detectAtTrigger(val)` which scans backward from end — confirmed.
- Word boundary: `@` preceded by whitespace or start-of-string — confirmed at lines 57-94.
- `resolveSearchDir()` five cases: empty/`.` → cwd; `~` → home; `~/...` → home-relative; `/...` → absolute; default → cwd-relative — confirmed at lines 102-133.
- `resolvePathParts(base, rest)` splits at last `/` → `(directory, filePrefix)` — confirmed at lines 135-142.
- Async loading: `loadFilesInDirCmd` calls `os.ReadDir`, filters dotfiles, appends `/` to dirs, uses `filterByPrefix()` (case-insensitive `strings.HasPrefix`), caps at 5 when `useDefault=true` — confirmed.
- Directory caching: when `searchDir` matches, re-filters `allItems` without filesystem hit — confirmed at lines ~154-158.
- Render popup: `completionPanelStyle.Width(width)`, title via `wizardTitleStyle`, loading/no-matches states, up to 8 items with scroll window — confirmed.
- Scroll window: `start = max(0, selectedIndex-7)` — confirmed at line ~288.
- Selected/unselected styles: `selectedProviderStyle` (prefix `> `), `unselectedProviderStyle` (prefix `  `) — confirmed.
- Navigation keys: `up`/`ctrl+p` → `navigateDown()` (note: the actual source maps `up` to `navigateUp()` and `ctrl+p` to `navigateUp()` as well in app.go; `down` and `ctrl+n` map to `navigateDown()`). The solver's phrasing "`up`/`ctrl+p` and `down`/`ctrl+n` call `navigateUp()`/`navigateDown()`" correctly implies the pair mapping. Confirmed.
- `Esc` → `clearCompletionAndRelayout()` sets `m.completion = nil` and triggers `m.relayout()` — confirmed.
- `applyFileCompletion()` uses `buildAtRef()` preserving path prefix: `@sub/` + `foo.go` → `@sub/foo.go`; `@foo` + `bar.go` → `@bar.go` — confirmed at lines 225-240.
- Tab on directory (ends with `/`): appends without trailing space, keeps popup open — confirmed.
- Tab/Enter on file: appends with trailing space, closes — confirmed.
- Command completion: `syncCommandCompletion()` triggered by `/`, uses `commandCompletionItems(query, registry)` filtering from `CommandRegistry.order` — confirmed.

**No contradictions found.** Every claim matches the source code.
